description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Cloud' that extends a system engine model and manages database operations related to 'product_bestseller' such as install, uninstall, edit totals, delete, and report retrieval.

classes.name: Cloud
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing 'product_bestseller' data within the OpenCart system, including operations like install, uninstall, update, delete, and report retrieval.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table in the database if it does not already exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the 'product_bestseller' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates or inserts the total sales count for a given product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product from the 'product_bestseller' table based on its product ID.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller products ordered by total sales, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries in the 'product_bestseller' table.
